notes.title: Patch Notes 2025.3.18
notes.content:
Major Update: Unity 6 Migration
We’re excited to announce a massive technical leap for our game! We’ve migrated the entire project from Unity 2022 to the cutting-edge Unity 6. This upgrade brings significant improvements to performance, visuals, and future scalability, ensuring a smoother and more immersive experience for all players.

Key Updates
Unity 6 Engine Migration

The game has been fully rebuilt using Unity 6, leveraging its advanced rendering pipeline, enhanced physics, and optimized performance capabilities.

Expect smoother gameplay, faster load times, and better compatibility with modern hardware.

Performance Boost

Thanks to Unity 6’s optimizations, the game now runs more efficiently across all devices. Frame rates are more stable, and memory usage has been significantly reduced.

Players on lower-end systems will notice a marked improvement in performance.

Visual Overhaul

Unity 6’s upgraded rendering features have allowed us to enhance the game’s visuals. Lighting, shadows, and textures now look more realistic and dynamic.

New post-processing effects and improved particle systems add depth and polish to the game’s atmosphere.

Physics and Interaction Improvements

The migration to Unity 6’s updated physics engine has made in-game interactions more responsive and lifelike. Collisions, animations, and environmental interactions feel more natural.

Codebase Refactoring

The entire codebase has been refactored to align with Unity 6’s best practices. This improves stability, reduces bugs, and makes future updates easier to implement.

Several legacy issues have been resolved, resulting in a more polished experience.

Future-Proofing

This migration sets the stage for future content updates and expansions. Unity 6’s flexibility and power will allow us to deliver new features and improvements faster than ever before.

Known Issues
As this is a major engine upgrade, some players may encounter compatibility issues. If you experience any problems, please report them via our support channels.

Older hardware may not fully support Unity 6’s advanced features. We recommend updating your drivers for the best experience.

What’s Next?
We’re already working on new content, including levels, characters, and gameplay features. Stay tuned for more announcements!

Continuous performance optimizations and bug fixes are planned to ensure the game runs smoothly for everyone.

Thank You for Your Support!

This migration to Unity 6 is a huge step forward for us, and we’re thrilled to bring you a better, more polished version of the game. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’re committed to making this the best experience possible. If you have any questions or suggestions, don’t hesitate to reach out through our community forums or support channels.

Best Regards,
The Development Team

Note: We recommend backing up your save files before updating, just in case. Enjoy the new and improved experience!
